title: Design Twitter
description: Design a simplified version of Twitter where users can post tweets, follow/unfollow users, and get the 10 most recent tweets in their news feed.
pseudocode:
1. postTweet(userId, tweetId): tweets.unshift({userId, tweetId})
2. follow(followerId, followeeId): following[followerId].add(followeeId)
3. getNewsFeed(userId): 
4.   feed = []
5.   for tweet in tweets:
6.     if tweet.userId == userId or following[userId].has(tweet.userId):
7.       feed.push(tweet.tweetId)
8.       if feed.length == 10: break

steps.note: Checking tweet 6 (posted by User 2, followed by User 1)
